source: Dallas City Code ch. 51P, Article 587 (City Attorney's codified article, April 2026)

sections.title: Legislative History
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-587.101. LEGISLATIVE HISTORY.

PD 587 was established by Ordinance No. 24357, passed by the Dallas City Council on August 23, 2000. Ordinance No. 24357 amended Ordinance No. 19455, Chapter 51A of the Dallas City Code, as amended. (Ord. Nos. 19455; 24357; 25163)

sections.title: Property Location And Size
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-587.102. PROPERTY LOCATION AND SIZE.

PD 587 is established on property generally located at the northern corner of Lone Star Drive and Terre Colony Court. The size of PD 587 is approximately 2.9205 acres. (Ord. Nos. 24357; 25163)

sections.title: Definitions And Interpretations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-587.103. DEFINITIONS AND INTERPRETATIONS.

(a) Unless otherwise stated, the definitions and interpretations in Chapter 51A apply to this article.

(b) Unless otherwise stated, all code references to articles, divisions, or sections in this article are to articles, divisions, or sections in Chapter 51A.

(c) This district is considered to be a nonresidential zoning district. (Ord. Nos. 24357; 25163)

sections.title: Development Plan
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-587.104. DEVELOPMENT PLAN.

(a) For a public or private school use, development and use of the Property must comply with the development plan (Exhibit 587A). In the event of a conflict between the provisions of this article and the development plan, the provisions of this article control.

(b) For all other uses, no development plan is required, and the provisions of Section 51A- 4.702 regarding submission of or amendments to a development plan, site analysis plan, conceptual plan, development schedule, and landscape plan do not apply. (Ord. Nos. 24357; 25163)

sections.title: Main Uses Permitted
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-587.105. MAIN USES PERMITTED.

(a) Except as provided in Subsection (b), the uses permitted in this district are all uses permitted in the IR Industrial/Research District, subject to the same conditions applicable in the IR Industrial/Research District, as set out in the Dallas Development Code, as amended. For example, a use permitted in the IR Industrial/Research District by specific use permit (SUP) is permitted in this planned development district only by SUP; a use subject to development impact review (DIR) in the IR Industrial/Research District is subject to DIR in this planned development district; etc.

(b) Public or private school. [SUP] (Ord. Nos. 24357; 25163)

sections.title: Accessory Uses
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-587.106. ACCESSORY USES.

As a general rule, an accessory use is permitted in any district in which the main use is permitted. Some specific types of accessory uses, however, due to their unique nature, are subject to additional regulations in Section 51A-4.217. For more information regarding accessory uses, consult Section 51A- 4.217. (Ord. Nos. 24357; 25163)

sections.title: Yard, Lot, And Space Regulations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-587.107. YARD, LOT, AND SPACE REGULATIONS.

The yard, lot, and space regulations in Section 51A-4.123(c), “Industrial/Research (IR) District,” apply to this planned development district. (Ord. Nos. 24357; 25163)

sections.title: Off-Street Parking And Loading
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-587.108. OFF-STREET PARKING AND LOADING.

Except as otherwise provided, consult the use regulations in Division 51A-4.200 for the specific off-street parking/loading requirements for each use. For a public or private school use, the minimum off- street parking requirement is two spaces for each classroom. (Ord. Nos. 24357; 25163)

sections.title: Environmental Performance Standards
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-587.109. ENVIRONMENTAL PERFORMANCE STANDARDS.

See Article VI. (Ord. Nos. 24357; 25163)

sections.title: Landscaping
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-587.110. LANDSCAPING.

(a) Landscaping and tree preservation must comply with Article X.

(b) Plant material must be maintained in a healthy, growing condition. (Ord. Nos. 24357; 25163)

sections.title: Signs
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-587.111. SIGNS.

Signs must comply with the provisions for business zoning districts in Article VII. (Ord. Nos. 24357; 25163)

sections.title: Additional Provisions
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-587.112. ADDITIONAL PROVISIONS.

(a) The entire Property must be properly maintained in a state of good repair and neat appearance.

(b) Development and use of the Property must comply with all federal and state laws and regulations, and with all ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. Nos. 24357; 25163; 26102)

sections.title: Compliance With Conditions
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-587.113. COMPLIANCE WITH CONDITIONS.

(a) All paved areas, permanent drives, streets, and drainage structures, if any, must be constructed in accordance with standard city specifications, and completed to the satisfaction of the director of public works and transportation.

(b) The building official shall not issue a building permit or a certificate of occupancy for a use in this planned development district until there has been full compliance with this article, the Dallas Development Code, the construction codes, and all other ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. Nos. 24357; 25163; 26102)

sections.title: Zoning Map
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-587.114. ZONING MAP.

PD 587 is located on Zoning Map No. K-5. (Ord. Nos. 24357; 25163)
